versions.line: Every question on a task's card now has Skip this one
With tasks at work the panel and the bar are asked for far less often
A panel drawn again with nothing new in it costs less in a chat with many tasks
A pointer resting on the disk's speed in the line above the prompt shows how much disk space is used
With several tasks and helpers at work, Claudopus uses less of the processor
Every value on a question or a result that you would paste somewhere else, such as an account or case number
Claudopus installs and runs on Windows, in the Claude app's Code tab or in a terminal
A busy chat uses far less of the processor
A task that can no longer be reached, such as one a rewind of the chat left behind
On battery, Claude's commands get only a few fast cores at once, and the rest move to the Mac's slow
A task's part of its result, passed on by the chat, shows in that task's coloured box
When your Mac is busy, Claudopus no longer reloads itself again and again in a chat whose Claudopus is…
The grey quote over a coloured reply is now the message it answers wherever you sent it
A command Claude Code blocked now always shows Allow beside Don't allow on its card
Rewinding a chat in the Claude app no longer empties its panel
A file Claude sends you or a report names now opens when you click it
The moving rings on a card's helpers and commands keep turning smoothly as rows come and go around them
Text you pasted into a message shows in its quote as your words, without the marks around it
A task's card shows the pages, pictures and documents its result names
The chat no longer ends its replies with a line about which cards wait for you
A coloured reply quotes the message of yours it answers
Each coloured reply quotes, in small letters under the task's name, what you wrote to start that task
The box above the chat for a task takes that task's colour
Reply on a coloured reply opens the box above the chat for that task
The boxes for every area are back under the Progress chart
Memory moved from the top of the panel into Config, under You
Config has Task colours, off unless you turn it on
The Progress chart is now the areas themselves
Each month of the Progress chart now shows what you worked on that month, not today's goals
The Progress chart shows one month at a time, with a press to earlier months back to your first results
